name: serverless
description: Serverless Framework skills for AI coding agents: build, deploy and operate applications on AWS Lambda with serverless.yml and the serverless CLI, with Dev Mode, MCP servers, sandboxes and upgrades to v4.

interface.longDescription: Gives your agent the Serverless Framework skills: how to write serverless.yml, deploy and operate services on AWS with the serverless CLI, and read the documentation that ships with the CLI, plus one skill per feature: Dev Mode for running a deployed stage's functions locally against live AWS events, MCP servers on AWS Lambda, sandboxes for untrusted or AI-generated code, and upgrades from v1-v3 to v4.
defaultPrompt: Create a Serverless Framework service with an HTTP API and a DynamoDB table
Deploy this service to a dev stage and show me its endpoints
Find out why my last serverless deploy failed
